name: Lattice Weaver
method: Built-in image generation from inspected front and rear; one left anatomy refinement, failed draft retained.
confirmed: Four view files retain dark brass plates, gold ribs, violet joints and a rear violet spinneret.
Back hides the facial eyes and pincers behind the abdomen. Left and right face their named screen directions.
Profiles omit baked silk threads to support later runtime effects.
limitations: Eight-leg anatomy is NOT approved. Initial left draft shows excess feet; refined left has only seven clearly visible tips and right only six clearly visible tips. Occlusion alone does not establish the missing leg chains.
Profile rear leg roots appear distributed along or under the abdomen rather than all attached to the compact cephalothorax. A canonical socket map and separated leg chains are required.
Profiles remain oblique with frontal eye and pincer surfaces, not strict orthographic side elevations.
Abdomen proportions, gold rib patterns, spinneret dimensions and stance differ across views.
Front/back contain baked silk threads; these must be removed from body layers and implemented as effects between moving leg anchors.
No runtime animation clips or isolated articulated parts exist for this set.
next: Resolve eight-leg socket topology before rigging. Create four near and four far leg chains with fixed segment lengths, a shared body design and independent silk VFX; visually verify idle, alternating gait, ranged attack, hit and joint-folding death.
